result.rationale: In googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts the diff replaces `const key = googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` (which returned the parsed data) with `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema)`, and parseRefreshTokenResponse returns `refreshTokenResponse` — the full safeParse result wrapper `{success, data}` — not `.data`. That wrapper is then written directly to `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`, corrupting the stored credential shape on every refresh and hiding refresh_token inside `key.data`, breaking subsequent refreshes.

judged_text: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the full ZodSafeParseResult wrapper ({success, data}) but Google Calendar stores that wrapper directly as the credential `key` (previously `googleCredentialSchema.parse(googleCredentials)` returned the parsed data). On every deployment (sync enabled or not), the first Google Calendar token refresh overwrites credential.key with {success:true, data:{...}}; on the next refresh cycle googleCredentials.refresh_token is undefined, myGoogleAuth.refreshToken(undefined) fails, and all Google Calendar availability/booking operations throw — the real refresh_token is buried in wrapper.data and every user must reconnect the app.
